name: console-boot
description: Launch to gameplay and first-visit hitches, docs/console-boot.md. Every variant against the baseline (what ships, the game's own switch defaults included) with a cold cache (none for the title; pass --driver-cache-dir to clear the GPU driver's too), a second cache (what the same variant's cold run left: the second play of a game) and a warm cache (a copy of your own cache as the suite found it), three times, alternating the order. Each variant file in variants/boot names the cache states it runs in. Every run boots the game, loads the Hyrule Field save, checks the scene and measures; the row has the boot phases since the process started, the held draws and builds from the first frame to the scene, and the stutter frames from the log.

variants.name: baseline
variants.description: What ships: no switch beyond the shipped nx2_switches.txt and the game's switch defaults.
